dct_description_sm: This is designed to provide the public with information regarding inspections of all geographically fixed recreational water facilities premises in Waterloo Region. Please be advised that the results of all inspections posted here describe what the Public Health Inspector (PHI) observed on the date of inspection. This data is not intended to guarantee the conditions of a recreational water facilities premise at all times and should not be relied upon for that purpose.
